description: Turn one sentence about a plan or errand (for example "Friday dinner for 8", "packing for a weekend with kids", "ערב שישי ל-8") into a ready-to-use list written by Justy. No account needed. Returns the items (grouped by aisle for shopping lists) and a justlistapp.com link where the user can keep the list, share it, or open it in the app. Use this when the user wants a list drafted and has not connected a Just List account; with a connected account prefer write_list_with_justy, which saves it.

lang.description: Language for the list when the sentence alone is ambiguous: he (Hebrew) or en (English). Defaults to the sentence's language.

sentence.description: The user's request in one sentence, in their own words and language

name: draft_list

alternativeUrl.description: Where to make the list without Justy

keepUrl.description: Opens the draft on justlistapp.com, where the user can save it to their account or get the app

aisle.description: Aisle token (produce, dairy, …) for shopping lists; null otherwise

title: Draft a list with Justy
